title: Q-DOER-Q-TICK: build the doer for family Q-TICK (net inflow 1, 1 open, nothing closes them)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** throughput pass: family Q-TICK has net inflow 1 with 1 open and no doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation throughput --doer Q-TICK
**Status:** closed

Items of family `Q-TICK` arrive faster than anything closes them: 1 opened and 0 closed in the window, 1 open now. A family with net inflow and no doer is missing a loop, a probe or a closer. Build it: either a module that closes these items from their own records (then register it under `config.doers.Q-TICK` of mechanism family-throughput in doctrine/qnfo-port.json), or give the items closing probes the contracts loop can run (foundation/contracts.py). Closing items by hand does not count: the probe passes when a doer is registered or the family drains.

size: M

**Evidence:** closed by the pull request that carries this change
